title: RiverCreek vs The Preserve at Corkscrew Estero FL: Which Is Right for You? 2026
excerpt: RiverCreek and The Preserve at Corkscrew share a property line but were built about a decade apart. The Preserve costs less to buy but carries a CDD and 2012-2015 roofs nearing Florida's 15-year mark; RiverCreek is newer, has no CDD, and has impact windows standard.
